title: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Insights into the Assembly of Lanthanide-Containing Clusters
claim: Anions can both compensate charge during lanthanide aggregation and template cluster architecture, but controlled release may be needed for anions that readily precipitate lanthanides.
explanation: The review contrasts anion-templated assemblies with a controlled-anion-release strategy used to construct high-nuclearity clusters.
conditions: Especially relevant to strongly charged anions such as oxalate, sulfate, and phosphate.
caveats: Anion effects are not necessarily sufficient by themselves; the review notes synergy among synthetic strategies.
